title: Canonical etale to pro-etale comparison on supported signed-twist Hom groups
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $P$, with coefficient ring $A=A_{E,n}$, and the two-site signed-twist supported Hom groups and exact comparison functor $
u_X^*$ of [def-pur-supported-class-operations]. For schemes $C,X$ and a closed immersion $i:C\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], and any integers $a,r$, define the canonical comparison
$$\operatorname{cmp}_i^{a,r}:H_i^a(X_{\mathrm{et}},A(r))\longrightarrow H_i^a(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A(r)).$$
Write $c_i:
u_X^*(i_*A_C)\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*A_C$ for the unique closed-source comparison carrying the image of the coefficient-unit restriction $A_X	o i_*A_C$ to the identical pro-etale restriction. For a representative $\alpha:i_*A_C[0]	o A_X(r)[a]$, the comparison is the composite of $c_i^{-1}[0]$, the exact derived inverse image of $\alpha$ with its canonical degree-zero and shift identifications, and the defining identification $
u_X^*A_X(r)=A_X(r)$ on the pro-etale site. This defines the map only; no bijectivity, product law or pullback compatibility is asserted.
